title: Decisions detail: pgdown and pgup skip content at heights 10, 16 and 24 (scrollDecision marker budget)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** Questions detail, Waves, Settings, sweep helper changes.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S588 observed TestScrollSweep/decisions-detail skip content with pgdown and pgup at heights 10, 16 and 24. The page step in internal/tui/decisions.go:scrollDecision advances by the available room without reserving the scroll marker lines. Example missing line: 2026-10-24 decision event number 08. S588 leaves these heights out under adj 575.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: Re-enable `TestScrollSweep/decisions-detail` at heights 10, 16 and 24 using the S588 fixture. It must currently fail with "never showed" lines in both paging passes.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Correct the decisions-detail page budget so pgdown and pgup expose every content line. Keep the S588 fixture and sweep helpers unchanged. Restore the excluded sweep heights and remove this pane's Left out entry once they pass. Include any changed behavior documentation in the same diff.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -run 'TestScrollSweep|TestSweepPaneFixturesScroll|TestSweepMissingNamesSkippedLines' ./internal/tui` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
